notes.title: Update #7 adds Casual Mode!
notes.notes:
CSM has been updated to version 1.0.1.1.

Changes:
-Increased ground acceleration by a small amount.
-Added casual mode, in which you lose candy instead of dying when touching spikes or falling in pits. You also have unlimited lives.
-Made it so you can continue in both casual and normal modes.
-Fixed a Game Over Menu glitch.
-Made adjustments to a few level layouts
-Made various adjustments to HUD/Menus.
-Other miscellaneous changes and polish.

--Mark (filling in for Daxter the Dachsund, who has decided he just feels like sleeping all day instead of fulfilling his role as business manager)

notes.title: Update #6 adds Trial Mode!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update #5 Keeps track of high scores for individual levels!
notes.notes:
CSM has been updated to version 1.0.0.5.

Changes:
-A level's score, broken down by candy collected and time remaining, is displayed at the end of each level.
-The high score for each level is kept track of and displayed at the end of each level.
-Adjustments to Pirate's Mark Level 3 and Crystal Caves Level 2.
-Title Screen Music was changed.
-Added sound effects, including ambient sounds before the start of each world.
-Various adjustments to the HUD/UI.
-Sparkles.
-Other miscellaneous changes and polish

Bark bark!

--Daxter the Dachshund, Business Leader and Hierophant of High Scores

notes.title: Update #2 is now live!
notes.notes:
CSM has been updated to version 1.0.0.2.

Player Control has been slightly adjusted to make things more accessible for new players. This should be especially helpful for players using keyboard controls. If you want Colette to control closer to how she did in the initial release (which allows more precision but is a little less beginner friendly), you can play in Classic Mode.

Changes:
-Can now choose between normal mode and Classic Mode when starting the game.
-For normal mode, how jump input is handled has been adjusted.
-Classic Mode removes the option to continue and enables precision jump height, which makes Colette start descending the moment you release the jump button.
-Slightly adjusted the timing when releasing the hook.
-Level adjustments to Pirate-3 and Castle-1.
-Minor adjustments to menu input.
-Other Miscellaneous changes and polish.

Bark bark!

--Daxter the Dachshund, Business Leader and Baron of Bark

notes.title: First update live! Can now continue your game (or disable the use of continues).
notes.notes:
CSM has been updated to version 1.0.0.1. 

Through the wonders of modern technology, you can now continue from the beginning of the last world you reached if you get game over or close and re-open the game! There is a sharp candy penalty, but if all you care about is finishing the game this should make it a little easier.

For purists there is also an option to enable Classic Mode, which disables the use of Continues, for a more retro experience. To enable Classic Mode, select Options --> Gameplay Options from the Title Screen.

Changes:
-Continues added to the game
-Classic Mode added, which disables the option to use Continues.
-Octopus bopping hit boxes adjusted
-Other Miscellaneous changes and polish.

Bark bark!

--Daxter the Dachshund, Business Leader and Master of Mystery
